title: Rare fifth-century burials of Germanic chieftains with dazzling weapons and warhorses discovered in France
caption:
Archaeologists in France have unearthed a rare fifth-century burial site. Two men were buried with high-status weaponry and their warhorses, offering a glimpse into the violence following the fall of Rome.

Source: Livescience - Rare fifth-century burials of Germanic chieftains with dazzling weapons and warhorses discovered in France
